restarts.why: the agents' rules changed (six temperaments with a daily mood, deployment caps, a daily ramp, every action with its reason) — a book run under different rules is a different book; the old one is kept in history/

rules.cautious: deploys at most 30% of the crore, 3% a position, two new a day, only names with conviction ≥ 70, a stop 30% tighter than the desk's; out at 15 sessions; respects the gate; a hostile tape scares it (fear up to +25), a benign one barely tempts it
rules.balanced: deploys at most 60%, 5% a position, three new a day, conviction ≥ 55, the desk's own stop, 2R target; out at 15 sessions; respects the gate; reads the tape both ways (±12)
rules.aggressive: deploys up to 90%, 8% a position, five new a day, takes anything with conviction ≥ 40 including early movers and the ranker's shorts, a stop 40% wider; out at 15 sessions; takes longs through the gate; a benign tape makes it greedier (+22), a hostile one barely scares it
rules.fno: every full setup on the F&O desk (regime prior + board + the future's own book on one side), long or short, 5% each, at most 70% deployed; the desk's stop, 2R, 15 sessions; no mood
rules.calls: every open call on the ledger, whichever model made it, 5% each, at most 70% deployed; out when the ledger closes the call; no mood
rules.tape: what the whole-market screen sees: early movers long (new 20-week high with relative strength — stop 8%, target 16%, 20 sessions) and the 5-session ranker's laggards short where a future exists (stop 6%, target 12%, 5 sessions); no mood, no gate
